title: Implement DELETE /api/prospects/[slug] and DELETE /api/batches/[id] routes
description: Create delete routes for removing individual prospects and entire batches (with cascade delete of all associated prospects and media).
acceptanceCriteria: DELETE /api/prospects/[slug] removes prospect and its media records
DELETE /api/batches/[id] removes batch, all its prospects, and all its media
Both return 204 No Content on success

steps.details: Export DELETE handler. Find prospect by slug. Delete media records for prospect. Delete prospect record. Return 204.
Export DELETE handler. Find batch by id. Delete all media for batch. Delete all prospects for batch. Delete batch. Return 204.
Create a batch with prospects. DELETE /api/batches/[id]. Verify 204 and that all prospects are gone from the DB.
